notes: Easier To Read: Every box now has a clear outline in day and night mode, hint text inside empty boxes is darker, and locked boxes such as Stock ID are easier to read.
Night Mode: Cards, boxes and lines stand out from each other more, and the search box in a record window stays dark when you type in it.
Back To Where You Were: Closing something you opened from a supplier, contract, lead or product window now takes you back to that window instead of the page.
